svg.aria-label: Where each model pays, measured in D5 on the laptop after the three dashboards were proven identical, relative only, ranges over the measured runs. Counter write per order: embedded 2,600 to 3,500 bytes of redo, the lookup pipeline nothing extra, converged 870 to 950 bytes. Dashboard read for one region: embedded 0.3 to 0.8 ms, the lookup pipeline 234 to 262 ms, converged 0.6 to 0.9 ms. A costlier read than one stored document, zero write amplification, and the optimizer plans the join
